system.flavor:
Pull a dropped key up out of a grate, drag a person back from a ledge by a step, yank a chair out from under someone, or tug a hanging rope into reach. One person-sized thing, one short pull.

Not enough to lift anyone off the ground or drag a cart.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Force Damage and pull it 1 unit toward a visible point within 2 units of it.

surges.html: Deal +1 Force Damage if the target ends adjacent to a solid obstacle.

rider.title: Space Thread
rider.html: Gain a Space Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: choose a visible empty space within 2 units as its origin. Measure its Range and area from that space.
